reviews.text: Marisa is excellent. She cleary cares for the animals she grooms.  She was incredibly sweet and gentle with our dog, Jolene.  We know this because she sent videos while grooming her, which was such a nice touch.  And of course, the cut was fantastic!  Highly recommended.
I took my dog ​​for the first time and we were delighted. They were very professional, the way they treated the pets was wonderful, and the result was perfect. Thank you so much!

I'm absolutely delighted with the care and kindness shown to the animals. The staff are wonderful—kind, respectful, and incredibly careful with the animals. Our dog Lucas started with Marisa, and for him and for us, she's part of the family. We feel so safe leaving our dog in her hands. Thank you for doing your job with such care and affection. Lucas comes out looking gorgeous and confident.
My cat came out relaxed, as if he'd just left a spa. Wonderful!

I took my two Persian cats to get groomed and brushed. The service was incredible; they cared for them so much and treated them with such affection. The result was amazing—they were free of knots and their fur looked super fluffy. I highly recommend this service if you have a cat and want to give them the care they deserve.
Thank you so much! I have a cat over 15 years old, with a strong personality, and you treated her with so much patience and love, I never expected it! You're the best. A million thanks ❤️
Excellent service for my dog's nail trimming, the only place she's happy going, you can see they work with love.

I took my Persian kitten to be shaved a couple of days ago because his fur had become very matted. They did it without anesthesia, and I was so surprised at how calm he was! They let me be present the whole time and treated him with so much patience and care. They trimmed his nails, shaved him, bathed him, dried him, and cleaned his ears, all in just one hour, and he looks immaculate. As for the price, they charged me €60, which I thought was very reasonable for the excellent service they provided. I will definitely be back for a maintenance appointment, as I was extremely happy with the results.

I took my cat Pelusa to the groomer and I couldn't be happier with the result. They treated her with so much love, patience, and professionalism. You can tell they have experience with cats and care about their well-being at all times. Plus, she looked gorgeous and so soft. We'll definitely be back. 100% recommended! 🐱❤️ …
They demonstrated great professionalism and treated them with the same love and care as if I had done it myself; they're softer than ever. Delighted with the experience, I can't give them 7 stars.
Delighted with the attention, dedication, and love shown to my kitten! I loved it, we will definitely be back...

I take my poodle, Curly, to Belfos dog and cat grooming salon in Valencia, and I couldn't be happier. The first time we took her, since it was her first time at a groomer's, the owner closed the salon just for her so she wouldn't feel overwhelmed. The result was spectacular: she looked gorgeous and perfectly groomed.

The second time, she was very matted after a weekend of adventures in the countryside. Instead of taking the easy way out and shaving her, they spent three hours working on detangling her, spread over two days, so as not to hurt or stress her. That says a lot about how much they love animals and the passion they put into their work.

I wholeheartedly recommend Belfos to anyone who has a poodle or any dog: for their professionalism and, above all, for the exceptional care they give to the animals. 💖💖💖

I've been taking my Persian cats to this groomer for months. They take great care of them and always return them looking their best! Plus, they avoid sedating the cats if possible, which was very important to me when choosing a groomer. You need to book an appointment a couple of weeks in advance.

Absolutely thrilled!!!

After searching for ages for a cat groomer in Valencia, I finally found Belfos and I couldn't be happier. It's so hard to find a place that truly cares for cats, and even harder to find one that handles cases with significant matting without resorting to sedation. Here, they didn't need to sedate her at all, which gave me so much peace of mind.

My cat was super relaxed throughout the entire process and left calm, stress-free, and very well cared for. You can tell they have experience with cats and treat them with so much patience, love, and respect.

Plus, I thought the price was very reasonable, and the service from the whole team was excellent. The staff were incredibly kind, friendly, and very professional, explaining everything to me and making both my cat and me feel like we were in good hands.

Without a doubt, this will be our go-to groomer. I 100% recommend it to anyone who has a cat and is looking for a trustworthy place in Valencia. Thank you so much for the wonderful service!

I took my cat (a Persian cat) in because his fur was incredibly matted and he wouldn't let anyone brush him.
The people at this groomer's did a wonderful job. They were careful, gave my kitty a treat as a gift, and worked with great patience. I highly recommend this place!
Super professional, they provided exceptional service, explained everything in detail, and gave us great peace of mind. We will definitely be back.
Maria Jose is an excellent groomer. She loves animals and pays attention to every detail. Our little puppy came home beautiful, clean and happy. I highly recommend Belfos!!

We were so happy with the great work they did on my cat. She's a British Longhair, and I didn't know how to get rid of the knots that were stuck to her skin. I was desperate! I saw this grooming salon online and read the positive reviews. It was a bit far from where we live, about an hour away, but we decided to go anyway. The service was a 10/10, the work was a 10/10, I recommend them 100%. Thank you both so much! 🙂🥰😺

This is the first time I've taken my cat there, and they were absolutely wonderful. They showed so much love and patience, especially since he's always been afraid of water and new places. I would recommend them to anyone who asks. Thank you so much for everything!
My dog ​​left super happy! She's shy, and Monica knew how to handle her from the very first minute ☺️
Highly recommended!!! ❤️❤️❤️❤️

The best groomer for our furry friends.

I'm thrilled with this groomer. I've been taking my dog ​​there since he was a puppy, and I've always been amazed by the patience, dedication, and care with which María José, Marisa, and the entire team work.
They are friendly and professional, and they inspire complete confidence from day one. The haircuts they give are wonderful, always respecting the owner's wishes and prioritizing the animal's well-being. You can truly see the love they have for dogs. I have 100% confidence in this special team. I highly recommend you visit them as soon as possible: your furry friend couldn't be in better hands!

We have a Maltese, Chiqui, who will be 19 years old in two months. We've been taking him to Belfos for many years, and we'll continue to do so for as long as he lives. Both María José and Marisa are fantastic professionals and very loving with animals. They deserve our highest rating!
Excellent service and professional care

Trimming my dog's nails is a true art, and this groomer does it with so much care and patience. Many thanks to M. Jose and Marisa, true professionals both in their work and in the love they put into it.

They're attentive, advising, listening, and respecting the client's needs. Exquisite treatment with the pet. Loli never runs away when you enter 😂😂 and leaves without rushing. What better review could there be? 🥰🥰
Nail trimming, washing, styling, and cutting. Unbeatable price for the time they dedicate. 😊😊

I took my Siamese cat, Lio, a couple of weeks ago, and the service was fantastic. They were excellent professionals, and above all, they took great care of my cat. He was very comfortable, and I will definitely be back.

Thank you so much!

After years of taking my dog ​​to be washed and groomed, today they told me they wouldn't take her because she's old and they'd feel bad if something happened to her. They said that because I seemed overwhelmed, they preferred not to take her, even though all I said was that she gets tired of standing and should sit down whenever she can because she has arthritis. I'm incredibly disappointed. It's blatant discrimination, something I never thought I'd experience here after all these years. Who do we entrust our dogs to if they prefer not to care for them when they get older? Choose any other dog groomer; there are plenty who know how to treat both clients and senior dogs.

Yesterday I took my little one and I'm delighted with the personalized service. As soon as he sees them, he wags his tail, and I love that. They have everything you could ask for, from pet food and accessories to any kind of supply. Highly recommended! I'll be back next week.
I go every month to get his nails trimmed and a bath. Tito is so calm and happy, and they make him look so handsome. I'll keep coming back. Thank you so much, M. Jose and Marisa, for taking such good care of him. You're both wonderful!
Very professional. I took my dog ​​to have his nails trimmed because other places wouldn't touch them due to their dark color, and they did an excellent job. 100% recommended.

A wonderful and highly recommended experience! They treated my cat like royalty and made her look absolutely gorgeous. Thank you so much for your work, and I will definitely be bringing my cat back! 🤗 …
They are very good

I'll definitely be back to this place; the way they treated my cat was amazing. They're so gentle with all the animals, and that makes you feel completely at ease. You can tell they love what they do. Thank you so much for taking such good care of Tigger!

I'm delighted with the team at Belfos. I always take Nilo (my exotic shorthair cat) there when summer comes so he can stay cool, and Pepa (my wirehaired mixed breed) too. They both look gorgeous when they come out, and Pepa always wears a bow, which makes her look adorable. I must say that the people who work at Belfos are lovely; they treat the animals with so much care and pay close attention to detail. It's my go-to pet groomer in the neighborhood.

I took my long-haired cat to get her fur trimmed because it was matted and needed tidying up. They treated her with such care that they even gave her a bath. When I went to pick her up, she was so calm, I was amazed.
I highly recommend Belfos. 10 out of 10.

I highly recommend them; they're cat whisperers. They manage my rather difficult cat perfectly. Other places force me to give her up, but here, I don't know what they do, but they calm her down much better and without having to sedate her. A perfect ten!
Simply wonderful. I was hesitant because my cat doesn't go outside, but the service was fantastic. I will definitely return and recommend them without hesitation.

My experience has been incredible. They are super professional and very caring. I really appreciate their professionalism, but above all, the wonderful way they always treat my dog.

In the past, he always got very nervous whenever I took him to the groomer. Here, however, he's much calmer, and that assures me that they take very good care of him.
Without a doubt, I recommend them 100%.

A wonderful and highly professional experience with my kitten Ares' groomer. She knew exactly how to make him feel comfortable, and after the bath, treatment, and drying, his fur was incredibly soft. Highly recommended!

Insta IG: elmainecoonderuzafa
Very kind, excellent service. They took my cat, who was covered in motor oil (black), and did a fantastic job. 100% recommended.

We took our 17.5-year-old dachshund in for just a trim, as he can no longer tolerate the noise of the dryer. The team was incredibly kind, patient, and caring with him—they treated him with genuine care and respect. They always greet us with a smile when we bring our two dogs in, and seeing how they treat other dogs with the same gentleness was truly impressive. I would recommend this place to anyone looking for a groomer who truly cares.

Thank you so much for everything. Aragon and Aston

A 10 out of 10! Super professional and caring! I took my cat to get his fur shaved and his nails trimmed, and I couldn't be happier with the result. They treated him with so much love and patience, and the best part is that they didn't put him to sleep or sedate him! That gave me so much peace of mind. They even showed me a video of the process, and it was beautiful to see how they took care of him the whole time. He came out calm, handsome, and happy. It's a place where you can really see the love for animals. I will definitely always go back to Belfos!

My experience wasn't good. I went in happy and came out almost in tears. Right in front of me, they pulled a knot out of his fur with a comb until it came out, and the cat whined. And he's a cat who lets them do anything. You don't pull knots out with a comb; you cut them in half and then pull them out so the animal doesn't suffer. I even said I'd do it myself at home, seeing how much they were pulling. I hate to have to post this, but I left there feeling awful. I told them not to cut his nails, and I was only there if they weren't. I had to remind them. A sad experience.
They are lovely and very attentive to my cat Hermes, they do a great job, plus the price is reasonable, I recommend them.
Today we took Lola, our giant poodle with a lot of knots, for a trim and haircut. We are delighted with the result and especially with the service we received from María José and Marisa.

Row is a heavy greyhound who doesn't want to go near water, but he behaves so well at Belfos, leaving so proud. And it's not just Row; all my greyhounds have been cared for by them, and the love they show is amazing. Thank you so much for loving our dogs so much.

HIGHLY RECOMMENDED!
I first went on my uncle's recommendation, as my 18-month-old Golden Retriever was afraid of the groomer, and since we started going there, HE LOVES IT. The service is wonderful for both pets and humans.
If you need to take your pet to a groomer, definitely go to Belfos.
A real find! Our puppy Woody had a wonderful experience. He was so happy and treated with the utmost care. We'll definitely be back. Very professional. We are so grateful.

It was a wonderful experience with our German Shepherd puppy. They washed, brushed, and perfumed him beautifully. We were worried he might misbehave, but on the contrary, he was very well-behaved, happy, and very relaxed. They treated him wonderfully. We will definitely be back.
We also have a cat.
Thank you so much for your work! You are the best. What you do isn't just a job, it's amazing. We recommend you one hundred percent.

I found them through a Google search, and it was my first visit. I have a Persian cat with a lot of knots, impossible to comb. I took her there and was delighted. The poor things got a scratch and a bite, but in the end, they were able to shave her because it was impossible to remove the knots by combing. With a lot of patience and a few well-placed combs... They are lovely, and I will continue taking my Luna there to get her groomed as soon as her fur grows back! 10 out of 10
Incredible service! 😱 I loved how they did my dog. I'll definitely be back. They're very professional, kind, and friendly, and I completely trust them. I 100% recommend this place! 💜💜🐶🐶🐶🐶🐕 …
I'm delighted with this hair salon. Excellent work and outstanding service! I highly recommend it!
I've been taking my cat Iris there forever; they are professional and lovely, they couldn't treat animals any better, totally recommended, thank you for always being so attentive.
Five stars aren't enough; I'd give them a million! This place is fantastic for furry friends. …

I went with a Himalayan Persian cat who suffers from feline acne. They were incredibly patient with him and left him looking absolutely gorgeous and clean. The cat was very comfortable; it's clear they love animals and treat them with so much care. We'll definitely be back and highly recommend them.
Fantastic. They do a wonderful job with our dog and are incredibly patient and friendly.
M. Jose and Marisa are both wonderful professionals and absolutely lovely with my dog ​​Mini and all the pets they care for. For me, they're number one in Valencia.
Highly recommended! Very professional, they've gained another customer 😸HERCULES😼 …
